task: M8R-10 — Watchlist and Evidence Workbench Integration — Preflight

canonical_ui.legacy_route_decision: /workbench/mode-a/ remains a compatibility alias or redirect decision for implementation; no third workbench
canonical_ui.technology_constraint: plain HTML, CSS, and JavaScript only; no React, Vue, npm, or CDN

product_authority_matrix.persistent_watchlist: M8R-09 installation-local SQLite at data/watchlists/watchlists.sqlite3; only durable watchlist authority
product_authority_matrix.identity: installation-local Taiwan Market Identity Service; ISIN is durable cash identity and MARKET:CODE is cached listing/routing identity
product_authority_matrix.unified_request: unified_market_evidence_request.v1; preserve v1 unless a demonstrated implementation gap requires a separately governed version
product_authority_matrix.capability: canonical Unified Capability Catalog and /api/unified/capabilities projection
product_authority_matrix.execution: existing Mode A validation, Mode B1 preview, Mode B2 authorization/execute-once, and fixed source adapters
product_authority_matrix.result_audit: server-owned Mode C canonical Result, audit, and AI handoff
product_authority_matrix.ai_skill: current tw-market-evidence-agent and docs/agent_usage_guide.md; no direct SQLite or raw notes exposure

adapter_contract.proposal: server-owned, read-only watchlist-to-Unified-Request composition service, then existing Mode A validates the composed request
adapter_contract.target_projection: input=instrument_id (ISIN), resolution_requirement=exact, client_target_reference=watchlist_entry_id; market_hint comes only from the current Identity Service projection
adapter_contract.version_binding: the selected watchlist version and revision hash are frozen before validation; a later N+1 mutation never silently changes the composed request
adapter_contract.provenance: server-owned selection sidecar or existing audit extension must bind watchlist ID, exact version, revision hash, selected entry UUIDs/ISINs, request ID, creation time, and request hash; it is not an undefined field in Unified Request v1
adapter_contract.legacy_reference: persistent_watchlist_reference remains compatibility-only for older 03C/03D consumers; it is never a SQLite locator and may only be projected from a verified revision
adapter_contract.no_execution: composition, validation, preview, result read, and handoff do not dispatch a market source

confirmation_domains: Watchlist mutation preview and confirmation: local persistent-state change only, no market network
Evidence authorization: governed approval of the exact previewed plan
Network Execute Once confirmation: one bounded market action
governance.invalidation: any target, data-need, preference, execution-mode, or selection change invalidates validation, preview, authorization, execution, and result state; a post-composition watchlist mutation leaves the prior request frozen and requires explicit rebuild to use current state
governance.selection_bounds: watchlist storage limit (500), workbench selection limit, and Unified execution bounds are separate. Catalog default target limit is 10 and hard target limit is 50. Over-bound selection must not auto-split, batch, or run in background.
governance.mixed_targets: one request may combine persistent then temporary targets; deterministic dedupe keeps the persistent entry as source for an equivalent ISIN and visibly suppresses the duplicate temporary target; every client_target_reference remains unique
governance.mcp: the existing six-tool Unified MCP contract remains unchanged; no watchlist-specific MCP tool is proposed

identity_and_selection_rules.ambiguity: present candidates and require explicit user choice; never select a fuzzy winner
identity_and_selection_rules.unsupported_cash: known unsupported cash instruments remain visible and persistable, but their non-executable capability state is shown and they are not silently dropped or executed
identity_and_selection_rules.unresolved: persisted unresolved identity remains visible; no automatic deletion, disabling, or migration
identity_and_selection_rules.successor: requires Review Migration followed by the existing M8R-09 mutation preview and explicit commit
identity_and_selection_rules.enabled: user selection preference only; it does not mean executable. Select Enabled is explicit.
identity_and_selection_rules.temporary_targets: ephemeral only. Promotion requires Add to Watchlist, M8R-09 preview, identity/listing/warning display, explicit confirmation, then commit.

capability_and_result_rules.capability_source: load from /api/unified/capabilities or canonical capability catalog; UI presets are mappings, not authority
capability_and_result_rules.result_explorer: show canonical Result/Audit and selection provenance when available; do not write results to watchlist notes or cache market values
capability_and_result_rules.ai_handoff: canonical server Mode C Result/Audit only; do not expose raw SQLite, full notes, or unselected entries
capability_and_result_rules.currentness: display source/retrieval timestamps, currentness status, and caveats without upgrading observations to realtime

rules: Only explicit Execute Once can invoke market retrieval.
Conflict, expired preview, or stale identity context disables commit and forces reload/rebuild/reconfirm; never silently retry or rebase.
Accessibility requires semantic controls, keyboard operation, visible state text, and disabled actions that explain their prerequisite.

legacy_surface_matrix.M5K live-observation endpoints and legac: HISTORICAL_COMPATIBILITY; do not route M8R-10 execution through them
legacy_surface_matrix.frontend/readonly-preview/watchlist-work: LEGACY_READONLY_UI; redirect/deprecation decision belongs to M8R-10 implementation

implementation_slices.scope: read-only composition contract/service and deterministic tests
watchlist UI and mutation preview/commit integration using existing M8R-09 APIs
Workbench request builder, selection provenance, A/B/C state integration, and compatibility routing
bounded end-to-end acceptance with explicit Execute Once only

acceptance_matrix: Watchlist CRUD uses existing preview/commit endpoints and preserves optimistic concurrency, expiry, single-use confirmation, and zero-or-one default.
Persistent selection binds exact version and entry UUIDs; temporary targets are clearly nonpersistent.
Ambiguous, unresolved, successor, known-unsupported, and Security-Master-unavailable paths fail closed or require the specified explicit review.
Composed request passes the existing Unified Request v1 schema and Mode A validation without bypass.
B1 preview, B2 authorization, and network Execute Once retain separate confirmations and no automatic dispatch.
Mode C Result Explorer and AI handoff preserve provenance and make no extra market request.
E2E: persistent-only selection; temporary-only selection; mixed deterministic dedupe; selected-version mutation after composition.
